editorial:
Imagine taking a wrong turn in the middle of nowhere and ending up in the hands of a family that treats humans like livestock. You get a nasty feeling right away as you meet these backcountry butchers who spend their days carving up anyone unlucky enough to wander onto their land. The vibe is gritty and mean, making you feel like there is absolutely no way out once the traps snap shut. It feels like a bad dream where the people hunting you are just doing their daily chores, which makes the whole thing even creepier.

What really works here are the gross-out effects and the way the tension builds up. Some parts move a bit slow, but the gore makes up for it if you love that kind of stuff. If you are into slasher flicks that don't hold back, you should definitely give this a go. It is a solid pick for a weekend scream-fest with friends.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a bloody fight for survival. After a lot of screaming and chasing, the main characters try to fight back against the family. Most of the butchers get killed off in violent ways, but the movie leaves you with the chilling feeling that this kind of evil exists in many hidden places. It ends with a grim reminder that some people are just monsters, and not everyone makes it out alive.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty survival horror and gore.
